case: Failed MySQL batches preserve direct UPDATE and DELETE effects on non-transactional engines
contract: For each tested engine, a batch mutates a table directly and then fails on an absent table at statement 1.
InnoDB direct UPDATE and DELETE effects are rolled back.
MyISAM, MEMORY, and CSV direct UPDATE and DELETE effects remain visible after the failed batch.
This establishes only the named engines and direct DML effects; it does not establish atomicity for all MySQL engines or side-effect patterns.
